title: Derandomized BLR acceptance probability
statement: Let $n$ and $r$ be natural numbers, let the target be a function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to the signs, and let a seed map send each $r$-bit string to $(\mathbb F_2)^n$. The acceptance probability is the expectation, over independent uniform $n$-bit and $r$-bit strings, of the indicator that the derandomized BLR decision procedure accepts.
hypotheses_covered: A target function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to the signs
A seed map from $r$-bit strings to $(\mathbb F_2)^n$
caveat: The referenced decision procedure is not included in the supplied statement.
